source: Transcribed from the Rigol DSA800 Series Spectrum Analyzer Programming Guide (Aug. 2016). Both the setting and the query form of each command are printed in the guide's own Syntax block, so nothing here is generated by rule. All 197 commands named in the guide's per-subsystem Command List tables are present. Commands the guide marks with an asterisk need an option (EMI filter, tracking generator, VSWR) the base DSA815 does not carry. Repaired on 14 August 2026. The reader had been swallowing each entry’s parameter table into its description — 368 of them carried “Parameter Type Range Default Name …” after the prose — and giving the set form and the query form the same doubled text. The tables are cut, and where the guide writes the two sentences it prints for a pair, “Set …” and “Query …”, each form now carries its own; 324 pairs split that way and 44 entries have a single sentence covering both. :TRACe[:DATA] had lost its parameter clause to a wrapped syntax line, and that clause was sitting in the catalog as a command of its own, “TRACE1|TRACE2|TRACE3|TRACE4,<definite_length_block>|<comma_separated_ASCII_data>”, categorised System. The clause is back on the command and the orphan is gone.
